communityInsights:

• The services are beautiful, with some prayers sung in Latin, creating a serene and enriching experience.
• The sisters are described as joyful, prayerful, and compassionate, embracing guests with unconditional kindness.

• Sunday afternoons can be a quiet time for calm meditation and prayer, with few visitors aside from the brothers.
• The community is known for its spirit of compassion and a strong sense of community, making visitors feel welcomed and at home.
• Many find the atmosphere very spiritual, peaceful, and contemplative, with the spirit of the monastery being a key draw.
• Vespers are highly recommended and considered well worth attending.
• The brothers are described as gentle and welcoming, contributing to a family-like atmosphere.
• The chapel is open for visitors to see, and staff at the gift shop are noted for being very friendly.
